scenes.text: Look around you. Trees, bushes and grass are all plants.
The roots grow under the soil. They hold the plant firmly and take in water.
The stem holds the plant up. It carries water from the roots to the leaves.
Leaves are the kitchen of the plant. They make food using sunlight, air and water.
Flowers make the plant beautiful. Later, flowers turn into fruits.
Fruits keep the seeds safe. A seed can grow into a new plant.
Plants need water, air and sunlight to grow. Let us take care of them.

body.prompt: Which part of a plant grows under the soil?

solution.explanation: Roots grow under the soil and take in water.

body.prompt: Which part of a plant makes its food?

solution.explanation: Leaves make food using sunlight, air and water.

body.prompt: Which part holds the plant up and carries water to the leaves?

solution.explanation: The stem holds the plant up and carries water.

body.prompt: What does a plant need to grow?

solution.explanation: Plants need water, air and sunlight to grow well.

body.prompt: What does a flower later turn into?

solution.explanation: Flowers turn into fruits, and fruits keep the seeds.

body.prompt: A seed can grow into a new plant.

solution.explanation: When a seed gets water, air and warmth, it grows into a new plant.

body.prompt: Roots grow above the soil, high in the air.

solution.explanation: Roots usually grow under the soil.

body.prompt: Most leaves are ___ in colour.

solution.explanation: Most leaves are green.

body.prompt: Fruits keep the ___ safe inside them.

solution.explanation: Seeds are inside fruits, like in a mango or an apple.

body.prompt: Match each part of the plant to its job.

solution.explanation: Roots take in water, stems carry it up and leaves make food.

scenes.text: Just like us, animals need a home. A home keeps them safe from rain, heat and cold.
A bird builds a nest with twigs, grass and leaves.
Bees live together in a hive. They make honey there.
A rabbit lives in a burrow. A burrow is a hole under the ground.
A lion lives in a den. A spider spins a web.
Fish live in water, in ponds, rivers and the sea.
Some animals, like cows and dogs, live with people. We must be kind to all animals.

body.prompt: Where does a bird live?

solution.explanation: A bird builds a nest with twigs and grass.

body.prompt: Bees live together in a ___. Which word fits?

solution.explanation: Bees live in a hive and make honey there.

body.prompt: A rabbit lives in a hole under the ground. What is it called?

solution.explanation: A rabbit's home under the ground is a burrow.

body.prompt: Which animal lives in water?

solution.explanation: Fish live in ponds, rivers and the sea.

body.prompt: Why do animals need a home?

options.text: To stay safe from rain, heat and cold

solution.explanation: A home keeps animals safe, just like our homes keep us safe.

body.prompt: A spider spins a web.

solution.explanation: A spider makes a web with fine threads.

body.prompt: A lion lives in a nest on a tree.

solution.explanation: A lion lives in a den, not in a nest.

body.prompt: A bird builds its nest with twigs and ___.

solution.explanation: Birds use twigs, grass and leaves to build nests.

body.prompt: Bees make ___ in their hive.

solution.explanation: Bees make honey in their hive.

body.prompt: Match the animal to its home.

solution.explanation: Bird: nest, lion: den, rabbit: burrow, bee: hive.

scenes.text: All living things need water. People, animals and plants cannot live without it.
We use water to drink, cook, bathe, wash clothes and clean our homes.
We get water from rain, rivers, lakes, wells and taps.
Rain water fills ponds and rivers. It also goes into the ground.
We should drink clean water. Boiling or filtering water makes it safe to drink.
Do not waste water. Turn off the tap while you brush your teeth.

body.prompt: Who needs water to live?

solution.explanation: People, animals and plants all need water.

body.prompt: How can we make water safe to drink?

options.text: By keeping it open in the sun all week

solution.explanation: Boiling or filtering removes germs and dirt.

body.prompt: Which is a good way to save water?

options.text: Turn off the tap while brushing
Play with the hose all day

solution.explanation: Turning off the tap while brushing saves a lot of water.

body.prompt: Which of these is a source of water?

solution.explanation: We can get water from a well.

body.prompt: We use water for many things. Which one needs water?

solution.explanation: We need water to cook rice.

body.prompt: Rain water fills ponds and rivers.

solution.explanation: Rain water collects in ponds, lakes and rivers.

body.prompt: It is safe to drink dirty water.

solution.explanation: Dirty water can make us sick. We should drink clean water.

body.prompt: We should not ___ water.

solution.explanation: Water is precious, so we should not waste it.

body.prompt: Water that falls from clouds is called ___.

solution.explanation: Rain is water that falls from clouds.

body.prompt: Match the place to what we do with water there.

solution.explanation: We cook in the kitchen, bathe in the bathroom and water plants in the garden.

scenes.text: We need food to grow, to stay healthy and to play.
Some food comes from plants: rice, wheat, dal, fruits and vegetables.
Some food comes from animals: milk, eggs and honey.
Milk gives us curd, butter and paneer.
A healthy meal has many kinds of food, like roti, dal, vegetables and a fruit.
Wash your hands before eating, and do not waste food.

body.prompt: Which food comes from an animal?

solution.explanation: We get milk from cows, buffaloes and goats.

body.prompt: Which food comes from a plant?

solution.explanation: Wheat is a grain that grows on a plant.

body.prompt: Which of these is made from milk?

solution.explanation: Paneer is made from milk.

body.prompt: What should we do before eating?

solution.explanation: Washing hands removes germs before we eat.

body.prompt: Which animal gives us honey?

solution.explanation: Bees make honey.

body.prompt: We get eggs from hens.

solution.explanation: Hens lay eggs.

body.prompt: Eating only sweets every day keeps us healthy.

solution.explanation: We need many kinds of food, not only sweets.

body.prompt: Rice and ___ are grains.

solution.explanation: Rice and wheat are grains that grow on plants.

body.prompt: Take only what you can eat and do not ___ food.

solution.explanation: We should not waste food.

body.prompt: Match the food to where it comes from.

solution.explanation: Milk from a cow, egg from a hen, mango from a tree.

scenes.text: We have five sense organs. They help us know the world around us.
We see with our eyes. We see colours, shapes and light.
We hear with our ears. We hear music, birds and our friends.
We smell with our nose. Flowers smell sweet.
We taste with our tongue. Sugar is sweet and lemon is sour.
We feel with our skin. We feel hot, cold, soft and rough things.
Take care of your sense organs. Keep them clean.

body.prompt: Which sense organ do we use to see?

solution.explanation: We see with our eyes.

body.prompt: Which sense organ do we use to hear?

solution.explanation: We hear with our ears.

body.prompt: Which sense organ tells us that a lemon is sour?

solution.explanation: We taste with our tongue.

body.prompt: How many sense organs do we have?

solution.explanation: Eyes, ears, nose, tongue and skin: five sense organs.

body.prompt: Which sense organ helps us feel that ice is cold?

solution.explanation: Our skin feels hot, cold, soft and rough things.

body.prompt: We smell flowers with our nose.

solution.explanation: The nose helps us smell.

body.prompt: We hear music with our eyes.

solution.explanation: We hear with our ears, not our eyes.

body.prompt: Sugar tastes ___.

solution.explanation: Sugar is sweet.

body.prompt: We should keep our sense organs ___.

solution.explanation: Clean sense organs stay healthy.

body.prompt: Match the sense to its organ.

solution.explanation: We see with eyes, hear with ears, smell with the nose and taste with the tongue.
